comment: Dr. Erkulwater is the best professor I have had had UR! This course is extremely dense and interesting, and she breaks down difficult topics in ways that challenge traditional ways of thinking. She is extremely knowledgeable on what she teaches and also accessible outside of class. Definitely take her if you can!

Dr. Erkulwater is incredible! She is engaging, tastefully opinionated, and really wants to help you grow as a learner and writer. I almost dropped this class after realizing it's certainly not 'intro' to public policy, but I'm thankful she convinced me to stay. It is my favorite course and I have learned more than I ever have in a class. Take her!

Dr. Erkulwater is by far the best professor I have had thus far. In all honesty, I never did a reading and ended up doing well on both papers. I recommend using her office hours, as she has them daily and will essentially plan the essay with you. She is also super amenable to extensions on papers as long as you ask.

There were a lot of readings and only a few papers. The papers were graded very harshly, and the politics of social welfare were cool to learn about. But, she talks a lot about how her and her husband are very comfortable in today's world, and she brought it up on more than one occasion. This made me uncomfortable

Professor Erkulwater is one of the best professors I've had at the University of Richmond. She is always prepared for class discussions based-off the relevant assigned readings. She is always open to questions and will meet with you 1-on-1 to help guide you through each of the 3 papers throughout the semester.

Dr. Erkulwater has been my favorite professor at Richmond! She is a great lecturer and cares for her students! There are 3 papers and reading quizzes that make up your grade. You can view the reading quizzes before! Her class is very structured and is split into 3 sections: Budget, Immigration, and Healthcare. I love her class and HIGHLY recommend!

The class is interesting but mostly talks about how well off her family is while teaching about welfare programs 
 I also did not get a clear understanding of grading styles for papers. Not informative

Dr. E cares about her students SO much. Difficult grader, but super open to meeting with you in her free time (definitely do it for papers), and it is VERY helpful. Would recommend her to any student. Incredibly knowledgable, let us take the class in the direct we wanted, very kind. Do the readings and you will be totally fine. Grades nameless

Dr. Erkulwater is the best professor I've taken at University of Richmond. I would highly recommend taking her class. She's extremely organized, thoughtful, and helpful to her students. Yes, she has high expectations of her students, but she is always willing and available to help students with their essays.

Such an amazing and caring professor! There are a lot of readings, but come to class prepared and participate in discussions to really learn. She's always willing to meet and give you advice on paper and will help you put ideas into actual words. She is so knowledgeable and passionate and that energy comes through in class. Can't recommend more.

This FYS had a harsh grading scale, but Dr. Erkulwater is very open to meeting with students and puts extra work in for students who participate and put effort into the course! The topic is interesting, but the book the course revolves around is mediocre. Be prepared to write 3 essays (the first is 5 pages, the second is 7, and the final is 10).

Professor Erkulwater is a great professor to have. She is really caring and very kind. She wants he residents to succeed. Class can be really interactive on some days and on others it is more relaxed and you can just listen. She does give reading for homework most nights, but as long as you have an idea of what it is about you be fine.

Such a great professor. You really learn a lot in this class. There are three papers throughtout the semester and her expectations for them are very clear. Definitely go see her to go over your paper, she will tell you exactly what to change. Take her if you get the chance!

TAKE THIS FYS. The topic was interesting and prof E is very passionate about the topic. It was one of the easier FYSs offered but still feel like it help improve my writing skills a lot. 3 papers are written in the semester and professor E meets with the student to go over rough drafts. There a reading assignment each night but u Can skim them.

Absolutely love Dr. E, she's such a sweetheart! The material can be challenging, but she's extremely accessible as she makes a spreadsheet with times to meet with her to discuss your paper drafts (optional BUT TAKE ADVANTAGE) and is always very receptive to student questions. Overall, great class and I hope to take future classes with her!

A literal sweetheart, all of the reading is based on novels she's read and enjoyed, tends to be pretty liberal but doesn't grade down if you don't share her beliefs. Literally emails back in ten minutes and will outline all your papers with you!

Dr. Erkulwater is an amazing professor. Took this class for fun but still had loads of work (especially papers). She is a tough grader but has very specific guidelines. So, if you follow them and put in some effort, there is no doubt that you will do good.

She grades as if she expects her students to be experts at the topics, but she teaches very little in class. Class is composed of her lecturing about the books she assigns for homework, so there's very little she actually brings to the classroom. Difficulty of grading makes her a very difficult teacher.

Overall, really cares about her subject area and about her students. Made time to meet with students individually to discuss papers and would give feedback to assist in writing. Class usually consisted of lecturing about the readings. Aside from 1 novel, most readings were long and dense. Fairly tough grader, 3 major papers.
One of my favorite professors at U of R! She is so devoted to her work and makes class interesting. I learned so much in her class but also received so much help from her! Definitely take!

Really great prof, only thing is the subject is kinda boring. The first paper is really confusing, but after that it goes really smooth. She will help you no matter what; super organized and helpful. Just don't slack

Erkulwater is very demanding and makes you read a lot, but she is very fair. Email her drafts of your papers ahead of time for correction and go to her office hours with any questions. She is extremely helpful and very nice. Challenging but overall a good class.

Dr.  Erkulwater is the most organized professor I know.  She makes time for her students and utilizes all of the texts. She is a tough grader, but she maintains a blog with sample writings that tell what she is looking for. If you are interested in welfare politics, she's the one to go to. Class discussions and blogging opens your eyes.

She is a really tough grader when it comes to papers. I was never really sure what she expected to be in them. She is a really nice professor and very passionate with what she teaches. It's hard to really understand her unless you share that same passion.

Dr. E is the best professor of my sophomore year. She is very understandable, clear, fair grader, and always willing to help. She is always energetic at 9a.m. and engages her students.  She is very professional, but also has a motherly side outside of the classroom.  TAKE THE COURSE WITH HER!
Great Teacher, engaging, extremely smart, and a fair grader.
She is very engaging in class and is enthusiastic about the material.  She loves what she teaches, and class consists of interesting debate.  She is a very hard grader, though.
Difficult grader, expects far too much on papers, not the most helpful teacher. Take class at your own risk

Makes Public Policy pretty interesting.  Her grading of papers are very difficult, so be sure to use the writing fellow.  Teaches 4 or 5 areas of policy a semester, so there is something for everyone.  Lectures can get a bit dull.  I class debates get quite heated on certain subjects.
****. Helpful. Easy. Hot. Smart. Funny. Hot. Lenient. Hot.

What a professor should be. Challenging, engaging, and willing to help. Encouraged students to get beyond "typical" college writing to explore subjects from many perspectives. Maintains extensive office hours - every time I talked to her, we seemed to have hour long talks and lamentations about politics. Would take any course she offers.

She is a great prof. She's eager to help, enthusiastic about what she teaches, and very good at guiding class discussion. She welcomes questions and comes up with a lot of creative ways to teach you new things and get you interested. I would take any class she teaches because she is so great.
No Comments

Dr. Erkulwater is an amazing professor. She is very helpeful and there for her students. Her teaching is amazing and technique is enjoyable by most all of her students. I would take any class she taught. She is the model professor, that makes the political science department what it is. She is not "easy" she is fair, and a great professor!!

Dr. Erkulwater is one of my favorite professors at UR.  She's REALLY nice and genuinely cares about her students.  Class discussions are interesting, and she's very enthusiastic about what she teaches.  Two very enthusiastic thumbs up.
